description: This file defines a utility class 'PageBuilderUtils' that contains methods for constructing page-related strings, specifically for building URLs or page identifiers for error pages based on merchant store information.

classes.name: PageBuilderUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate page or URL strings related to merchant store pages.

methods.name: build404
methods.description: Builds the URL or page identifier for a 404 not found page specific to a merchant store, appending the store's template to a base path.
